7a77e72ec3fb27917d72165d36949f0f24713dff.summary: CrowdStrike's technical analysis of the WhisperGate malicious bootloader, reported in January 2022 as deployed against Ukrainian targets alongside a Discord-based downloader and a file wiper. The bootloader overwrites the master boot record, displays a fake ransom note and overwrites disk sectors, with no decryption or recovery mechanism. The report assesses with moderate confidence that the activity aims to destroy data, and finds no technical overlap with VOODOO BEAR so far.
